product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee Easy Maker | Authentic Pump Espresso Machine, 6 Piece, Chrome/Black
features: Authentic espresso made easy - scoop, slide, and brew
Consistent great taste without the mess through patented Auto Tamp Technology
Powerful milk frothing wand is removable for easy cleanup
Reversible drip tray accommodates a variety of cup sizes
15-bar Italian pump system extracts optimal flavor
description: The Mr. Coffee easy espresso machine is a must-have for Latte and Cappuccino lovers who enjoy the ultimate at-home espresso experience! Scoop, slide, and brew are all the steps needed to craft coffeehouse-quality espresso drinks. Simply scoop the grounds into the easy-fill Coffee filter drawer and slide it into place. The espresso machine will auto-tamp the grounds for consistent taste every brew and the 15-Bar Italian pump will extract rich, robust flavors for the perfect espresso drink. The milk frother easily steams and whips up milk into an airy consistency for lattes and cappuccinos. A reversible drip tray can accommodate a wide variety of mug sizes, from espresso Cups to an extra-large cappuccino mug.
